# The header restore icon consumes the existing IMAP-deleted button state

The CSS change overrides the ordinary trash icon only for .hdrTrashButton[data-imap-deleted="true"]. The checked header updater already chooses delete/undelete localization from the IMAPDeleted message flag and writes the same Boolean to the dataset. Keep icon presentation separate from message-state and command changes: this patch adds no new deletion action or accessible-label definition. Static source inspection only; no rendered or native accessibility result.

Scope: Message header delete/undelete presentation.
